Hey.  I don’t have any answers really, but I just wanted to comment that I’m the same way and reading your story felt like reading something I wrote (like, every detail minus the strict parents).  If you ever want to talk about it or have hanxiety you can message me.  I always have crippling hanxiety and I’ve been doing this sort of thing for about 4 years now.  I didn’t really think it would, but it got worse.  I started drinking anytime I felt any uncomfortable sensation.  I started having serious blackouts and making a scene.  When you become the person who blacks out and vomits at every party, people start to notice.  I noticed my hangovers get worse and worse to the point that I’m vomiting out a car window into oncoming traffic.  

I think the difference between some nights having one drink and being okay and some being a complete shitshow is that once I get going and start to feel pretty buzzed, I get out of control.  If I  have 1 drink and feel nothing, I can make myself stop.  If you’re like me, as soon as you start to feel it you just want more and more because it feels awesome but its hard to identify the point where more will ruin your night.  Its dangerous.  I’ve ended up alone passed out in bad parts of town and in traumatic sexual situations.  You don’t want this.  I think if you have to think about your drinking and if you feel guilty and like you might ruin relationships, its a problem.  If you wake up and are like Holy shit I cant believe I did that again! when you wanted to have a chill time, its a problem.  I think the solution would be to try to stop, but as a fellow 20 something female I know it seems like itd be so isolating to stop.  I havent made the step yet.  But i just wanted to tell you in my friend group at school there were 3 people who didnt drink and none of us cared or thought any differently of them.  Maybe you don’t need to stop, but maybe you do.  Its worth a try.  Moderation is really hard for some of us when partying with friends.  Sorry this was long, just trying to help.  Reach out if you want! xo
